newsitem.title: USA: Cryomedical gets FDA ok for Cryo-Lite.
newsitem.headline: Cryomedical gets FDA ok for Cryo-Lite.

text.p: Cryomedical Sciences Inc said Wednesday it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its new line of surgical instruments, to sold under the name Cryo-lite Series.
The Cryo-lite Series is a patent-pending technology consisting of self-contained, hand-held disposable instruments using both gas and liquid cryogens.
The company said its ability to sell the instruments gives it the opportunity to address all segments of the marketplace, including hospitals and clinics.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
